history.p: RWKV-4 one complete layer with expanded time-mixing mechanism. Main path: LN1 -> time mixing A -> residual addition -> LN2 -> channel mixing B -> second residual addition -> output. Expand ONLY time mixing A in linked detail: normalized current x and shifted previous x combine then project separate receptance r, key k, value v. Old recurrent accumulators decay exp(-w), current exp(k) times v writes numerator, exp(k) writes denominator; separate numerator/denominator readout yields normalized WKV, multiplied by sigmoid receptance then output projection. Show TWO accumulated state strips, NOT just one unnormalized summation. Reserve math labels and note stable rescaling omitted. Diagram connections actual mechanism, independent composition, plain flat memory strips.
